mission: Recover every usable bot and system under original-bots, bots, and attached_assets; reconcile them against the canonical App_bots fleet; and expose truly missing historical workers as supplemental Buddy-routable profiles without corrupting the verified 1,051 canonical baseline.

source_roles.bots: historical and current bot profile/archive material
source_roles.attached_assets: supporting uploads/assets; only bot/system definitions become worker candidates

identity_rules: Normalize slug, display name, capabilities and source before comparison.
Exact normalized slug matches remain canonical and are not duplicated.
Strong normalized-name matches with different slugs become merge_review instead of duplicate workers.
Bot-like records not represented in App_bots become supplemental_recovered workers.
System/code/config assets are retained in the recovery inventory even when they are not bot profiles.
Images, media, archives and ordinary attachments remain assets unless accompanying structured text identifies a bot/system definition.
Never delete historical source files during recovery.

supplemental_runtime.promotion_to_canonical_fleet: requires explicit reviewed onboarding, division placement, runtime tests, regenerated fleet evidence and updated baseline contract

truth_rule: Recovery proves source inventory and Buddy-routable shared sandbox profiles. It does not prove every recovered historical implementation still works; recovered workers must pass the same sandbox/runtime certification before production claims.
